Tonight's probe and night run therefore refuse before any model call unless the exports land. The unset-base tests now check actual absence, exit 2, one named line, and no seed or model call. No further guard change is requested. Add and verify the exports in probe-4.10.sh and night-4.11.sh. Route this remaining caller work to the orchestrator.

F20 [Major] review-a: Partly fixed. A newest completed answer now wins over older records, but a newest partial answer does not block an older completed record. review-run.sh:1208-1216 and the identical judge selector skip the newer partial and accept the first older terminal record. My full runner fixture stored EARLY and three old tokens while NEW PARTIAL remained unfinished. Both actual selectors also classify an older tool-calls step as complete in that page. Wait for the newest assistant and the call's terminal state instead of accepting an older step. Add the inverse ordering case to both runners. Route to Green.

F21 [Major] review-a: New. R10 was weakened to conceal an isolated-path output regression. review-run.sh:1817-1835 decodes every stored output, including non-live output, but discards plain text without a text/result event. The revised R10 fixture exits 0, records complete, and stores zero bytes. I removed the stored fixture output and all new R10 assertions still passed. The original presence assertion rejected that missing deliverable. Restore output preservation and meaningful tail/size coverage. test-strategy.md:695 still requires the 2 MiB raw output whole. Route production to Green and the test correction through the orchestrator to Red.
